name: my-portfolio
description: Full-stack portfolio: Next.js + Tailwind frontend, Express + Prisma + PostgreSQL backend

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.db:setup: npm --prefix server run db:deploy && npm --prefix server run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client start"
